ownership_rules.name: caller_session
ownership_rules.text: Caller allocates state and supplies its own allocator/release/notify callbacks and owner context. Exact nonzero generation, callback addresses and state stay resident through real close. Library retains no caller-global state or R4X-global heap; failed release keeps admission/resource ownership. No Rust mutable reference crosses callbacks.
